newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley CFO Scott has heart attack - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley CFO Scott has heart attack - NYT.

text.p: Robert Scott, the Morgan Stanley executive supervising the company's merger with Dean Witter Discover & Co, suffered a heart attack last week while on vacation, the New York Times said on Monday.
Scott is the company's chief financial officer and had been overseeing its $10.2 billion merger with Dean Witter.
The report said he had the attack while he was with his family in the Caribbean and that he was not yet well enough to be flown out.

It said Scott's illness could slow completion of the merger, although Stephan Newhouse, deputy head of Morgan Stanley & Co's securities business, is assuming Scott's responsibilities for the merger. -- New York newsdesk 212-859-1610
